### GT table: Two Carolinas

```{r two-carolinas-table, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Every FBS vs. FBS game for North Carolina and South Carolina since the start
# of 2025, side by side and newest first, grouped by season. Each game shows
# the opponent's logo, the point differential with the score underneath (OT
# marks overtime), and the opponent with the date. A team's three cells are
# shaded light green for a win and light pink for a loss.
#
# Reads a local snapshot of collegefootballdata.com games through October 3,
# 2026, so the post rebuilds without hitting the API.

teams <- c(unc = "North Carolina", sc = "South Carolina")
conference <- c("North Carolina" = "ACC", "South Carolina" = "SEC")
win_fill <- "#c8e6c9"
loss_fill <- "#ffd1dc"

team_games <- readr::read_csv(
  "two_carolinas_fbs_games_2025_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(diff = pf - pa, win = diff > 0)

signed <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x > 0 ~ paste0("+", x),
    x < 0 ~ paste0("−", abs(x)),
    .default = "0"
  )
}
record <- function(d) sprintf("%d-%d", sum(d$win), sum(!d$win))

team_logo_url <- function(team) {
  cfbplotR::logo_ref$logo[
    match(cfbplotR::clean_school_names(team), cfbplotR::logo_ref$school)
  ]
}
logo_img <- function(team, px) {
  sprintf(
    "<img src='%s' style='height:%dpx;vertical-align:middle;'>",
    team_logo_url(team), px
  )
}

# One row per (season, k-th most recent game), both teams side by side. UNC
# played one fewer 2026 game, so its last 2026 cell is blank.
game_cells <- team_games |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(game_date)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    k = dplyr::row_number(),
    ot = dplyr::case_when(
      !overtime ~ "",
      total_ots > 1 ~ paste0(" (", total_ots, "OT)"),
      .default = " (OT)"
    ),
    venue = dplyr::if_else(home | neutral_site, "vs", "at"),
    logo = logo_img(opponent, 30),
    # Differential on top, the score (and any OT) underneath it.
    diff_txt = paste0(
      "<div style='font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;line-height:1.1;'>", signed(diff), "</div>",
      "<div style='font-size:11px;font-weight:normal;color:#555;'>",
      dplyr::if_else(win, "W ", "L "), pf, "-", pa, ot, "</div>"
    ),
    result = paste0(
      venue, " ", opponent,
      dplyr::if_else(neutral_site, " (N)", ""),
      "<br><span style='color:#777;font-size:11px;'>",
      format(game_date, "%m/%d/%Y"),
      dplyr::if_else(conference_game, paste0(" · ", conference[team]), ""),
      "</span>"
    ),
    .by = c(team, season)
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(side = names(teams)[match(team, teams)]) |>
  dplyr::select(season, k, side, logo, diff_txt, result, win)

rows <- game_cells |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = side,
    values_from = c(logo, diff_txt, result, win),
    names_glue = "{side}_{.value}"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(season), k) |>
  dplyr::mutate(season = as.character(season)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    dplyr::matches("_(logo|diff_txt|result)$"), \(x) dplyr::coalesce(x, "")
  ))

# Under each team's logo:
#   4-11 overall (1-10 SEC)
#   -3 point differential (-103 in SEC play)
#   3-6 at home | 0-5 away | 1-0 neutral
site_record <- function(g, where) {
  site <- dplyr::case_when(g$neutral_site ~ "neutral", g$home ~ "home", .default = "away")
  record(g[site == where, ])
}

summary_html <- function(tm) {
  g <- dplyr::filter(team_games, team == tm)
  conf <- dplyr::filter(g, conference_game)
  cf <- conference[[tm]]
  paste0(
    "<div style='font-size:22px;font-weight:bold;margin-bottom:6px;'>",
    logo_img(tm, 40), " ", tm, "</div>",
    "<div style='font-weight:normal;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;'>",
    "<b>", record(g), "</b> overall (", record(conf), " ", cf, ")<br>",
    "<b>", signed(sum(g$diff)), "</b> point differential (",
    signed(sum(conf$diff)), " in ", cf, " play)<br>",
    site_record(g, "home"), " at home | ", site_record(g, "away"), " away | ",
    site_record(g, "neutral"), " neutral",
    "</div>"
  )
}

through <- max(team_games$game_date)
through_label <- paste0(
  format(through, "%B "), as.integer(format(through, "%d")), format(through, ", %Y")
)

football_icon <- paste0(
  "<img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/",
  "ESPN-icon-football-college.png' style='height:40px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;'>"
)

subtitle_sentence <- paste(
  "Similar records, different math, and lofty expectations.",
  "Every FBS vs. FBS game for North Carolina and South Carolina since the start of the 2025 season."
)

football_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;'>
     <div>{football_icon}</div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1;margin-left:30px;margin-right:30px;'>
       <span style='display:block;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;font-size:36px;'>Two Carolinas</span>
       <span style='display:block;font-weight:normal;text-align:left;font-size:16px;margin-top:6px;'>{subtitle_sentence}</span>
       <span style='display:block;font-weight:normal;text-align:left;font-size:12px;color:#666;margin-top:6px;'>
         <span style='background:{win_fill};padding:0 4px;'>win</span> |
         <span style='background:{loss_fill};padding:0 4px;'>loss</span> |
         Games through {through_label}
       </span>
     </div>
     <div>{football_icon}</div>
   </div>"
)

carolinas_gt <- rows |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "season", id = "two_carolinas") |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::cols_hide(c(k, unc_win, sc_win)) |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = c(unc_logo, unc_diff_txt, unc_result, sc_logo, sc_diff_txt, sc_result)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    unc_logo = "", unc_diff_txt = "+/−", unc_result = "Opponent",
    sc_logo = "", sc_diff_txt = "+/−", sc_result = "Opponent"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = gt::html(summary_html(teams[["unc"]])),
    columns = c(unc_logo, unc_diff_txt, unc_result), id = "unc"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_spanner(
    label = gt::html(summary_html(teams[["sc"]])),
    columns = c(sc_logo, sc_diff_txt, sc_result), id = "sc"
  ) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(unc_logo, unc_diff_txt, sc_logo, sc_diff_txt)) |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = c(unc_result, sc_result)) |>
  # Opponent width is set so the subtitle's last sentence fits on one line.
  gt::cols_width(
    c(unc_logo, sc_logo) ~ gt::px(50),
    c(unc_diff_txt, sc_diff_txt) ~ gt::px(70),
    c(unc_result, sc_result) ~ gt::px(212)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", size = gt::px(18)),
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = c(unc_diff_txt, sc_diff_txt))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(sides = "left", color = "#444", weight = gt::px(3)),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(columns = sc_logo),
      gt::cells_column_labels(columns = sc_logo)
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(
      gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", size = gt::px(14), color = "#2b2b2b"),
      gt::cell_fill(color = "#f2f2f2")
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(v_align = "top", color = "#2b2b2b"),
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners()
  ) |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(football_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(paste0(
    "<hr style='border:none;border-top:1px solid #ccc;margin:4px 0 8px;'>",
    "data via collegefootballdata.com, FBS vs. FBS games only<br>",
    "Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  ))) |>
  # The savant theme underlines spanners, and gt::cell_text() can't remove
  # that, so clear it with CSS.
  gt::opt_css(css = "
    #two_carolinas .gt_column_spanner,
    #two_carolinas .gt_column_spanner * {
      text-decoration: none !important;
      font-family: 'Roboto Condensed', sans-serif !important;
    }
    #two_carolinas .gt_column_spanner { border-bottom: none !important; }
  ") |>
  gt::tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    table.font.size = gt::px(14),
    source_notes.font.size = gt::px(11),
    data_row.padding = gt::px(4)
  )

# Shade each team's three cells by result.
for (side in names(teams)) {
  cols <- paste0(side, c("_logo", "_diff_txt", "_result"))
  win_col <- rows[[paste0(side, "_win")]]
  carolinas_gt <- carolinas_gt |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_fill(color = win_fill),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(cols), rows = which(win_col %in% TRUE))
    ) |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_fill(color = loss_fill),
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(cols), rows = which(win_col %in% FALSE))
    )
}

gtUtils::gt_save_crop(
  carolinas_gt,
  file = "two_carolinas.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
)

carolinas_gt
```
